descriptions.d26c_aim_update_800d4584: With buttons bit 0x08000000 subtract rate times dt from yaw at +176 and wrap up; with 0x04000000 add it and wrap down by 2 pi. Subtract axis x and y, scaled by the Desc rates and dt, from yaw and pitch at +176/+180. On 0x02000000 or a y axis call 0x800d47f0, on 0x01000000 or a y axis call 0x800d4734, with Desc+88 times dt.
